result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **QuickBooks Online is the best overall accounting software**\. However, depending on your business size, industry, and budget, there are a few alternatives that may be better.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best accounting software compared

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online**

(Best overall)

Starting around \$38/month

- Tracks income and expenses
- Creates invoices and financial reports
- Bank account synchronization
- Payroll and inventory options
- Widely supported by accountants

Best for: Established small businesses that want comprehensive accounting.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best alternative)

Starting around \$27/month

- Clean, user-friendly interface
- Unlimited users
- Excellent financial reporting
- Strong bank reconciliation
- More than 1,000 integrations

Best for: Growing businesses with multiple employees.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Books**

(Best value)

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$20/month

- Automates bookkeeping
- Manages customers and vendors
- Invoicing and expense tracking
- Inventory management
- Integrates with other Zoho products

Best for: Startups and budget-conscious businesses.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/us/books/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreshBooks**

Starting around \$23/month

- Very easy invoicing
- Tracks billable hours
- Estimates and expense tracking
- Client payment processing

Best for: Freelancers, consultants, and service businesses.

[FreshBooks website](https://www.freshbooks.com/)

---

![Wave Invoicing Price, Features and Reviews in 2026 | Techjockey US](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cq_WpVz7NNebV83eymwMqdJAwZrUT6jqdfnVn85XbYpCayHTlJrihkkO8LDrFvk-dswux7vYI-WyI9TwU0K5DaFdNOkf8d5Ia8Wr1grPRs_JxMDYMC_OytebLbRIC64BBKXa2wsOV86YjkDGJYJT3l4V90H4-W3LsFf4CLe4wjGwrIyhl4fSDhGvz9PUFynk?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Wave Accounting**

(Best free option)

Free accounting plan available

- Income and expense tracking
- Basic financial reports
- Unlimited estimates and invoices
- Paid add-ons for additional features

Best for: Sole proprietors and very small businesses.

[Wave website](https://www.waveapps.com/)

Pricing is approximate US pricing and can change. Features vary by subscription tier.
